## H1 — Intimacy (functional re-coding) {#h1}

### New categories (read these before the topics)

| Code | Category | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `I0` | **off target** | Not about romantic intimacy as defined below. Includes domestic errands, meals, animals, logistics, medical care, mentoring, generic plot talk, and non-romantic help. Prefer I0 over stretching any intimacy code. |
| `I1` | **emotional intimacy** | Disclosure, vulnerability, shared secrets, emotional closeness WITHOUT physical contact and WITHOUT reassurance-as-comfort as the main act. |
| `I2` | **reassurance** | Comforting, soothing, affirming safety/worth/the bond ("you'll be fine", "I won't hurt you", fever checks, watch-while-sleeping caretalk). Not kissing/holding. |
| `I3` | **nonexplicit affection** | ONLY when the dominant content is affectionate physical contact that is NOT genital/oral/penetrative: kissing, hugging, holding, caressing, undressing-as-prelude, non-genital touch. Ban I3 if there is no such contact in keywords/sentences. Kissing/clothes-removal alone are I3, never I6. |
| `I4` | **sexual tension** | Desire, anticipation, charged looking/invitation WITHOUT consummation and WITHOUT affectionate contact as the main act (eyes meeting, lip biting, longing, "want you"). |
| `I5` | **erotic escalation** | Building toward sex; heated undressing/touch progressing toward an explicit act, but not yet full explicit-sex focus. |
| `I6` | **explicit sex** | Explicit sexual acts (genital contact, oral sex, penetration, orgasm-focused intercourse). Do NOT code kissing, undressing, or non-genital caressing as I6 — those are I3. |
| `I7` | **aftercare** | Post-sex tenderness, checking in, bonding immediately after intimacy. |
| `I8` | **negotiation** | Consent talk, boundaries, stop-when-asked, preferences about intimacy/sex. |
| `I9` | **coercive sexuality** | Pressure, force, non-consent, or ambiguous consent around sex. |
| `I10` | **eroticized gaze** | Objectifying / erotic looking or appearance-focused desire without mutual intimacy or affectionate contact (watching body, beauty compliments as erotic appraisal). |

Topics with a non-null `intimacy_code`: **98**. Sentence tags use the unblinded cell key (`high_tier` → HIGH-rated, `low_tier` → LOW-rated).

## H4 — Protection vs possession {#h4}

### New categories (read these before the topics)

| Code | Category | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `H4_0` | **off target** | Not protection, possession, or care-control content. Generic plot or unrelated affect. |
| `H4_1` | **reassurance tenderness** | Soft reassurance / tenderness without an external threat frame. |
| `H4_2` | **practical care** | Practical everyday caretaking (not framed as protection from a threat). |
| `H4_3` | **material care** | Material provision as care (money/goods) without threat/control framing. |
| `H4_4` | **emotional support** | Emotional support / solidarity without external threat or claiming. |
| `H4_5` | **external protection physical** | Physical protection from an EXTERNAL threat (rescue, bodyguarding). |
| `H4_6` | **external protection social legal** | Social/legal protection from an EXTERNAL threat (advocate, lawyer, reputation shield). |
| `H4_7` | **possessive claiming language** | Claiming language ("mine", "belong to me") without clear coercion. |
| `H4_8` | **jealous possessiveness** | Jealous possessiveness toward rival/partner attention. |
| `H4_9` | **coercive control restriction** | Restricting partner autonomy / monitoring / isolation. |
| `H4_10` | **partner as danger** | Partner is the threat source (harm, intimidation). |
| `H4_11` | **for your own good control** | Control framed as "for your own good" / paternalistic restriction. |
| `H4_12` | **mutual care balanced** | Reciprocal, balanced care without dominance or threat. |
| `H4_13` | **mixed unclear** | Protection and possession/control signals compete with no clear dominant. |

## H5 — Darkness vs tenderness boundaries {#h5}

### New categories (read these before the topics)

| Code | Category | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `D0` | **off target** | Not darkness or tenderness content. Generic plot, logistics, or unrelated affect. |
| `D1` | **relational darkness** | Interpersonal / couple-level darkness (conflict, rupture, toxic dynamics). |
| `D2` | **partner harm control** | Partner-directed harm, control, or coercion. |
| `D3` | **external danger crisis** | External danger/crisis (storm, crime, accident) not partner-as-threat. |

| Code | Category | Definition |

| `ARC_0` | **off target** | Not a narrative-arc role for the main couple (or not arc content). |

| `ARC_10` | **unclear arc role** | Arc-relevant but role unclear / mixed. |
